notes: Single source of truth for every script/panel (references/pitfalls.md #3). blue/red/green/amber/purple/text/muted/grid are the categorical + text/UI palette used by scripts/polish_figures.py and documented in references/visual-style.md -- do not hardcode alternate hex values elsewhere. diverging_low/diverging_high are a colorblind-safe blue-red pair for signed data (log2FC, z-score); never substitute a red-green pair (references/pitfalls.md #1). sequential_colormap is the default for continuous magnitude-only data (references/pitfalls.md #2); never use rainbow/jet. max_categorical_hues caps color-only category encoding before a redundant channel (shape/text/facet) is required (references/pitfalls.md #12).
